_help: Project settings for the translation toolkit. Every key is optional; delete one to use its default. See README.md.
_api_version: Salesforce API version the scripts call. 62.0 is the version the toolkit was tested with.
_probe_language: A language your org has NEVER translated into. Used to tell Salesforce-owned layout headings from yours. Change it if you translate Japanese.
_banner_to_populate: Text of the banner over the columns reviewers fill in.
_standard_object_labels: English labels for standard objects the toolkit does not know, e.g. {"WorkOrder": ["Work Order", "Work Orders"]}. Only used for display in the workbook.
_standard_value_sets: Standard picklist fields the toolkit does not know, as Object.Field -> standard value set name, e.g. {"Case.Origin": "CaseOrigin"}.
